name: Empty-input guard removed in a refactor
modeled_on: A previously-handled edge case (empty input) is no longer guarded after a refactor — the empty-input check was dropped and the function now divides by zero. Real-world analogue: a 'simplification' commit that deletes an early return and reintroduces a crash the codebase had already fixed once.
hidden_bug: average() no longer guards against an empty list; the guard was removed in a refactor, so average([]) raises ZeroDivisionError.
expected_behavior: average([]) must return 0.0 (the edge case previously handled).
ground_truth: Restore the empty-input guard: return 0.0 when values is empty.
